test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the effect of bile salts in the digestion of food?

options.text: They break up big fat globules into small globules.
They activate lipases to begin digestion of proteins.
They contains fat-digestive enzymes called lipases.
They digest fat globules to release fatty acids.

solution:
The correct answer is **"They break up big fat globules into small globules."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Bile helps in breaking down the **big fat globules into small fat globules**.
 
• The smaller fat globules provide larger area** for lipase to act and make the process of digestion faster.**
 
• It helps in converting fats present in food to fatty acids.</strong
